A terminal inside the window, undo for git actions, staging single lines, blame, a conflict editor, interactive rebase, GitHub Issues, and an Agents view for running coding agents in worktrees.

### Terminal, inside Git Graph

- The **Terminal** button (or ⌃`) opens a terminal panel under the graph instead of another app. The inspector on the right keeps its full height.
- Each tab is your usual shell in the repository folder. Hiding the panel keeps the shells running while you switch views.
- **Open in external terminal** is still on the panel bar and in the command palette.

### Undo and redo

- **Undo** and **Redo** in the toolbar, or ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z: commits, amends, merges, pulls, rebases, cherry-picks, reverts, branch switches, new and deleted branches, and tags.
- Undoing a commit keeps its changes staged. Undo never overwrites uncommitted edits, and it says so when the branch has moved on since.

### Stage single lines

- Every hunk in Changes has **Stage**, **Unstage** and **Discard** buttons.
- Click lines in the diff (shift-click for a range) to stage, unstage or discard only those.

### File history and blame

- Right-click any file → **File history**: every commit that changed it, following renames, with its diff.
- **Blame** shows who last changed each line, newest commits highlighted. Click a commit to see it.

### Conflict editor

- **Resolve…** on a conflicted file shows our side and their side for each conflict. Take ours, theirs or both, edit the result, then **Save and mark resolved**.

### Interactive rebase

- Right-click a commit → **Interactive rebase from here…**: drag commits into a new order, and pick, reword, squash, fix up or drop each one. ⌘Z undoes the whole rebase.

### Issues (⌘7)

- Your repository's GitHub issues: open, assigned to you or closed, with the conversation. Comment from the app, and **Start branch** creates a branch named after the issue.

### Agents (⌘8)

- Your worktrees with what each has changed. Start Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot or OpenCode (whichever are installed) in a terminal tab in that worktree, and see which are running.
- **New worktree for an agent…** creates a folder on a new branch and starts an agent in it.

### Notices are easier to see

- Notices have a coloured edge, a tinted background and a bar showing how long they stay.
- They play a soft sound: a chime for successes and news, a lower tone for errors. Turn it off in **Settings → Notifications → Sound**.

### Fixes

- Opening a repository at launch no longer fails with "Too many open files".
- Branch and tag rows in the sidebar keep their spacing when the sidebar scrolls.
- Merge commits no longer list some files twice.

### Install

Use **Update** in the app (Settings → About), or download the file below. The builds are not signed with a paid certificate yet: right-click the app and choose **Open** the first time (or run `xattr -cr "/Applications/Git Graph.app"`). Pull requests, Issues, Actions and CI/CD use the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com) sign-in (`gh auth login`).
